items.q: What should you remember about **Depth over breadth**?
items.a: **three core home-base tools** used extremely well beats trying every hyped product.

items.q: What should you remember about **Life-map organization**?
items.a: **tools grouped by life zone** (life map ai tool categories), not by vendor or category label.

items.q: What should you remember about **Human touch in content**?
items.a: **AI education creator who keeps** filming/editing human; AI assists research, assets, companions, not on-camera delivery.

items.q: What should you remember about **Cowork morning brief**?
items.a: **emails + Slack +** calendar + portfolio + focus in one no-code workflow.

items.q: What should you remember about **Claude chat**?
items.a: **planning, trivia, travel, hardware** how-tos (Logitech mouse, layover planning).
**when you want cited** multi-model answers across sources; VPN workaround in restricted regions.

items.q: What should you remember about **Coding intensity ladder**?
items.a: **Claude Code (deep codebase autonomy) →** Warp (agent orchestration) → Cursor (IDE familiarity) → Codex (specialized / subscription bundling).

items.q: What should you remember about **Prototype vs production**?
items.a: **Bolt for fast functional** UI prototypes; Retool for business-specific internal apps.

items.q: What should you remember about **Agent building**?
items.a: **Cowork/Hermes for local workflows;** n8n no-code; OpenAI SDK code path.

items.q: What should you remember about **Local inference**?
items.a: **Mac Studio 64GB M4** hosts open models for private/free 24/7 runs.

items.q: What should you remember about **Cowork as notification hub**?
items.a: **Discord, Notion, Slack, email** drafting in one agent layer.

items.q: What should you remember about **Custom meta-business software**?
items.a: **accounting/tax/bank coordination too specific** for off-the-shelf SaaS; built in-house with local models.
